title: Pokémon GO: Mega Ascension
description:
Mega Ascension week prior to the Mega Finale event. Accumulate Mega Energy from weekly raids.

Daily Mega Raid Rotation:
- Monday, Aug 31: Mega Venusaur, Mega Charizard X/Y & Mega Blastoise.
- Tuesday, Sep 1: Mega Pidgeot, Mega Beedrill & Mega Slowbro.
- Wednesday, Sep 2: Mega Houndoom, Mega Manectric & Mega Altaria.
- Thursday, Sep 3: Mega Gengar, Mega Banette & Mega Absol.
- Friday, Sep 4: Mega Latios, Mega Latias & Mega Rayquaza.

Event Bonuses:
- Up to 2 free Raid Passes per day.
- 1.5x Mega Energy from Raids.

title: Pokémon GO Fest: Mega Finale (Day 1 - Mega-Mewtwo X)
description:
Global Event. Main Raids: Mega-Mewtwo X.

Habitat Rotation (Local Time):
- 10:00 to 11:00 & 14:00 to 15:00: Verdant Lush
- 11:00 to 12:00 & 15:00 to 16:00: Mindworks Channel
- 12:00 to 13:00 & 16:00 to 17:00: Haunting Alley
- 13:00 to 14:00 & 17:00 to 18:00: Circuit Plaza

Bonuses: Unlimited remote raids. Special Backgrounds available.

title: Pokémon GO Fest: Mega Finale (Day 2 - Mega-Mewtwo Y)
description:

title: Super Mega Raid Day
description:
Special Super Mega Raid Day!

Huge rotation of Raid Bosses appearing frequently:
- Gyarados
- Beedrill
- Houndoom
- Venusaur
- Malamar
- Victreebel

Bonuses:
- Increased Shiny odds for featured Pokémon.
- 5 extra free Raid Passes from Gyms.

title: Raids: Zacian, Zamazenta & Shadow Thundurus
description:
Legendary Raids Update!

- Zacian and Zamazenta return to 5-star raids with their shiny variants enabled.
- Exclusive debut of Shadow Incarnate Forme Thundurus during weekend Shadow Raids (Saturdays and Sundays only).

Make sure to use Campfire to coordinate with your local community!
